money.label: A repeatable edge from a US retail account

earnings-surprise.label: Top-25 earnings surprise, 63-session hold
earnings-surprise.numbers: +4.24%/quarter over SPY, t 2.3, hit 0.49, payoff 1.6, all splits

surprise-x-revision.label: Surprise + analyst revision direction in the 10 sessions after
surprise-x-revision.rule: top-25 SUE among 63-session reporters AND consensus EPS for next quarter revised UP since the print (yfinance earnings_estimate history); 63-session hold; vs surprise alone

surprise-x-guidance.label: Surprise + raised guidance (8-K text)
surprise-x-guidance.rule: surprise top quintile AND the 8-K/press release contains a raised full-year guide (LLM tag from EDGAR text); 63 sessions

surprise-short-side.label: Bottom-25 surprise as a short / put debit
surprise-short-side.rule: bottom 25 SUE among 63-session reporters, short 63 sessions in shares and as a 70/40 put debit; the Q1 leg measured ~0 long-only, test the short

ranker-sector-cap.label: Ranker with a 5-per-sector cap
ranker-sector-cap.rule: same ranker, at most 5 names per GICS sector; the live cohort was 60% refiners

stress-reversal.label: Bottom-40 reversal composite, 10-session hold, VIX > 25
stress-reversal.numbers: +2.59%/hold in regime, hit 0.56; out of regime flat to negative; first live cohort (out of regime) +4.1%

stress-options.label: Stress reversal expressed as 21-DTE call debit
stress-options.numbers: 21-DTE 70/40 call debit -5% in regime, -16% out; long calls +4% in regime with median -36%, -11% out

stress-sector-neutral.label: Stress reversal, losers vs own sector ETF
stress-sector-neutral.rule: composite on the name's return minus its sector ETF; 10 sessions; VIX > 25

stress-vix-term.label: Regime = VIX/VIX3M > 1 instead of VIX > 25
stress-vix-term.rule: same book, regime defined by backwardation; compare hit and payoff

momentum.label: 12-1 and residual momentum, monthly
momentum.numbers: IC +0.024/+0.040 at 4 weeks, inside the noise bar, positive in all splits

momentum-crash-filter.label: Momentum switched off when VIX > 30 (Daniel-Moskowitz)
momentum-crash-filter.rule: 12-1 top decile long only when trailing-21 SPY vol < 30%; 21 sessions

value.label: FCF yield, buyback yield, net issuance

overextended-short.label: Short the top decile of 1-week return in bull tapes (the mirror of stress)
overextended-short.rule: top-40 reversal composite, short 10 sessions, VIX < 15; shares and 70/40 put debit

play-structures.label: Measured stock signals as option structures, held to expiry
play-structures.rule: surprise/ranker/stress x {70/40 and 50/25 call debit, 60d and 80d long call, 30/15 put credit} vs shares, held to expiry
play-structures.numbers: every option cell negative per $ risk after the round trip (bid-ask 12-57% of risk); shares +7.4%/+1.9%/+5.6%/+0.9% on the same dates; the stress long-call +100% was split-mismatched chains, +4% median -36% once removed

play-structures-exit-rules.label: Take-profit at 50% of max reward vs hold to expiry
play-structures-exit-rules.rule: same cells, exit when the spread reaches 50%/75% of width; needs daily chain marks (thinned chain caveat)

covered-call-on-book.label: Covered calls on the stock book's own names
covered-call-on-book.rule: surprise top-25 held 63 sessions with a 30-delta monthly call sold against each; vs shares alone

earnings-vrp.label: Earnings variance risk premium
earnings-vrp.numbers: +3.6pt seller edge in points; not reproduced in straddle P&L

condor-45dte-vrp.label: 45-DTE SPX condor only when VIX - realised > 5 pts
condor-45dte-vrp.rule: 16-delta wings, 45 DTE, exit at 21 DTE, only when VRP > 5; real SPXW quotes

vix-overlay.label: 1x always, 2x when VIX > VIX3M inside a golden cross
vix-overlay.numbers: 15.3%/yr vs 11.5% 2006-2026, DD 59%; must be margin not a leveraged ETF

overlay-stock-sleeve.label: Overlay's stock sleeve tilted to the surprise book

opening-range.label: First 15 minutes -> rest of day
opening-range.numbers: direction null; width forecasts range t 14-27

or-width-sizing.label: Feed the 09:45 range width into the 0DTE expected range

memecoins.label: Memecoins, every retail-visible strategy
memecoins.numbers: copying GMGN smart money -17% net at 5 min; birth-tape rules all negative; paper books A -9% (900), B -23% (400)

memecoin-bsc.label: four.meme (BSC) launches at retail latency
memecoin-bsc.rule: gmgn_recorder.py records bsc; score after a week

kalshi-pairs.label: Kalshi vs Polymarket same-window pairs
kalshi-pairs.numbers: +1-2c per $1 pair on ~100 contracts, last 2 minutes; venue closed to US

income.label: Add capital
income.numbers: the only measured route to $50k in 5 months

other-markets.label: Futures, FX, commodities, vol ETPs, special situations

vol-etp-timed.label: Short vol ETP only in contango with a real tail hedge
vol-etp-timed.rule: short UVXY when VIX/VIX3M < 0.9, hedged with a 10% OTM VIX call priced at the ask; 2011-2026

surprise-call-80d-resample.label: 80-delta surprise call on a doubled chain sample
surprise-call-80d-resample.rule: the one option cell near zero (+5%, n 80, B positive, C flat): re-pull chains for the surprise cohorts missing from the Dolt panel and re-measure; needs 300+ trades before it can lead

plays-desk.label: The Plays desk: measured signals as sized, timed, reasoned plays
plays-desk.rule: <=3 a week, Mon/Wed, shares lead (the measured expression), option legs printed with their measured number, ledger scores promised vs delivered
